capabilities: Read the active note in a side-panel speed reader
Control WPM, text size, panel zoom, and ORP focus during playback
Play, pause, stop, restart, and resume per-note reading progress
Highlight the current word in the source note while reading
Switch highlight colors between yellow, orange, and blue
extras: Desktop-only for the first release; in-note highlighting works best in source mode and mobile support is not validated yet. Includes developer docs (test vault, build pipeline) and a public security-review contract; states it is fully local with no network calls or accounts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read long or dense notes at a controlled pace while keeping the source note visible.
summary: Speed-reader panel that presents the current note word by word at a set pace, with optional highlighting of the current word in the note.
